subject: S22 must fix: live-auth e2e leaks HF_TOKEN into test-results error-context.md (Playwright call log prints the Authorization header)
body: apps/web/e2e-live/live-auth.spec.ts:26 exchanges HF_TOKEN for the Space JWT with Playwright's request context. On failure (here: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, because the request context ignores HTTPS_PROXY in the sandbox), error-context.md contains the call log including 'authorization: Bearer <token>' in plain text. Fix: do the JWT exchange in Node with fetch through the proxy (undici ProxyAgent or EnvHttpProxyAgent), outside Playwright's request logging, pass only the short-lived __sign value to the page, and never set secret headers on Playwright requests. Add a test that scans test-results for every secret env value after the live-auth run, failing on any match. Also make CI artifact uploads exclude error-context.md for e2e-live. The leaked file was local, gitignored and deleted; nothing was committed.
